purpose: Provide one clean map of the biological body, neurobiology, chakra/body-center symbolism and theology relations. Detailed owners remain authoritative for evidence; this file is the simple navigation and synthesis layer.
reader_rule: Read each row left-to-right: real biology → project meaning → theological/mythic comparator → boundary. Never reverse the arrow and treat symbolism as scientific proof.

systems.biology: Skin, somatosensory receptors, proprioception, vestibular systems and special senses establish body/world boundaries and continuous environmental sampling.
systems.project: Plane / membrane / Vessel boundary / outer court.
systems.boundary: The body boundary is distributed across sensory and predictive systems, not a single metaphysical membrane.

systems.biology: Enteric nervous system, microbiome, liver/pancreatic metabolism, endocrine and immune signaling form a distributed metabolic ecology linked bidirectionally to the brain.
systems.project: Garden / soil / digestion / transformation / Navel center.
systems.boundary: Microbiome composition is not a moral purity score; gut serotonin does not simply become brain serotonin.

systems.biology: Heart, lungs, blood, baroreceptors, chemoreceptors and respiratory control generate rhythmic internal signals tightly coupled to autonomic state and interoception.
systems.boundary: Emotion is not stored literally in the heart; Spirit is not oxygen, blood or breath.

systems.biology: Sympathetic/parasympathetic systems, vagal and spinal visceral afferents, brainstem nuclei, insula and cingulate networks continuously report and regulate internal bodily state.
systems.project: Ascending/descending body report loop; inward Eye; embodied Spirit-flow; biological neighbor for chakra sensations.
systems.boundary: No chakra maps one-to-one to the vagus, insula or a single ganglion.

systems.biology: Vertebral column protects/supports; spinal tracts carry ascending sensory and descending motor/autonomic information. C1 Atlas supports the skull; C2 Axis provides a pivot for head rotation.
systems.project: Ladder / Tree trunk / 33-step symbolic ascent; Atlas=bearer; Axis=turning/pivot.
systems.boundary: 33 vertebrae are anatomy, not proof of 33 metaphysical levels.

systems.biology: Brainstem arousal and autonomic systems help regulate wakefulness, respiration, cardiovascular function and state transitions.
systems.project: Lower Gate / wake-sleep threshold / life-support root beneath the House.
systems.boundary: Arousal systems are distributed and do not define soul or spiritual rank.

systems.biology: Hypothalamus regulates homeostasis, temperature, hunger, thirst, reproduction, stress, circadian coordination and pituitary/endocrine control.
systems.project: Steward / household manager adjacent to House; regulates needs and seasons rather than being the canonical House itself.
systems.boundary: Older Potato Room=hypothalamus language is historical project strata; canonical House mapping is thalamic.

systems.biology: Thalamic nuclei participate in sensory/motor relay, attention, arousal, learning, memory and thalamocortical coordination. TRN provides inhibitory modulation of thalamic traffic.
systems.project: Father's House / rooms / central interior; TRN=wall/gate/sieve.
comparators: John 14 Father's House with many dwellings
mustard seed as compact generative potential
systems.boundary: Thalamus is not the sole seat of consciousness or literal divine residence; TRN does not filter spiritual frequencies.

systems.biology: Hippocampal systems support episodic/contextual memory; amygdala contributes to affective salience/threat learning; basal ganglia participate in action selection, habits, reward and cognitive-motor loops; cerebellum contributes to timing, prediction, error correction, learning and cognition.
systems.project: Thought/Memory return loop + judgment/action selection + correction/refinement. Cerebellar arbor vitae adds a genuine anatomical Tree-of-Life name.
comparators: Tree of Life as name-comparator only
systems.boundary: No single structure equals Thought, Memory, Judgment or Tree of Life.

systems.biology: Ventricles contain CSF; CSF circulates through ventricular/subarachnoid spaces and participates in buoyancy, homeostasis and transport. Perivascular/glymphatic exchange is linked to sleep and clearance but remains an active research area.
systems.project: Inner chamber / River / Spirit-flow analogue / Tomb-as-empty-space metaphor.
systems.boundary: CSF is not Holy Spirit; glymphatic flow is not spiritual purification.

systems.biology: Pineal gland produces melatonin under circadian control; retinal light information reaches the suprachiasmatic clock and influences pineal output indirectly.
systems.project: Son / Single Eye / Door / timing threshold / light-dark marker.
systems.boundary: Pineal is not a human photoreceptor, projector of spiritual light, or proven seat of soul.

systems.biology: Cortical sensory, association, executive, default-mode and salience networks support perception, planning, self-related thought, attention and model-building through distributed interactions with thalamus and subcortical systems.
systems.project: Rooms opening into the world / narrative map / Observer's changing model / branches of House.
systems.boundary: Networks are not theological dimensions and EEG/fMRI states do not map to spiritual rank.

systems.biology: BBB, meninges, immune signaling, astrocytes, microglia and oligodendrocytes regulate protection, metabolism, myelination, inflammatory surveillance and maintenance of neural environments.
systems.project: Walls / groundskeepers / repair crews / protected Garden.
systems.boundary: Immune activation is not sin, impurity or karmic punishment.

systems.biology: Experience alters synaptic strength, network organization and gene regulation; development, stress, learning and environment interact across multiple biological timescales.
systems.project: Growth / pruning / grafting / seed becoming Tree / transformation over time.
systems.boundary: Epigenetics does not encode mystical destiny or measurable karmic debt.

chakra_overlay.rule: Chakras are phenomenological/symbolic centers overlaid on many biological systems; they are not hidden organs.

theology_chain: John 15: Father as Gardener / vine / branches / fruit
definition_of_finished: A topic is finished enough for baseline use when it has a biological description, project role, comparator, mismatch/boundary, owner and chronology status. New discoveries extend the atlas but should not create duplicate owners.
